reviews.t: Has been the best for a long time now

My mother has been using it her whole life and I swear she looks 20 years younger than she is because of Clinique products. This keeps my face moist and feeling good for the whole night and even the next day when i apply after an evening shower. the best!

reviews.t: Great 60+ year old skin thanks to this moisturizer!
reviews.x: I have been using Clinique for more than 40 years.  I live in the desert and my skin for my age looks great.  I started using it when I was 16 and am now 62.  I use it twice a day. I constantly get compliments on my skin.  I attribute my skin to Clinique's 3 part skin program of which the moisturizer is part of the program.  I have very sensitive skin and the moisturizer is key to great looking skin.  I just wished the lotion had SPF protection.

reviews.t: DO NOT PURCHASE - either fake or expired product!

It smells very strongly of motor oil and has a greasy quality that is not consistent with the product I know. It made me break out almost immediately after applying. I have been using Clinique products for my skin since, 1976. I have very sensitive and allergic reactive face and neck skin and Clinique has been the safest and satisfying moisturizer I have found. It keeps my skin young and soft while moisturizing. Scent free, too. I love the whole beauty line. Thank you❣

I have been using this yellow moisturizer for 30 some years. The creme, not the gel, though the gel is probably just as good. It has no perfumes and has never triggered my hives. Sounds expensive, but a bottle lasts a good long time.

The product appears to be genuine and offers a good moisturizing base. It works well on sensitive skin and does not carry much of a scent. I have used Clinique products for years and have always been pleased.

claims.text: Many reviewers are long-term, loyal users who have used this moisturizer for years or decades and consider it a reliable favorite.
Reviewers frequently praise it as gentle and effective for sensitive skin, noting it is scent-free or has little to no perfume.
Several reviewers report receiving old, rancid, fake, or opened product with a foul smell, causing breakouts or being unusable.
Some reviewers note a discrepancy in scent, with one reporting the received lotion smelled strongly of perfume unlike the product they know.
Reviewers report it moisturizes well, does not clog pores, and helps with oily or breakout-prone skin.
